Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted a misleading search snippet and misidentified Bill Cosby’s third album as “Wonderfulness” (which is actually his fourth), then prematurely finalized the answer. The correct third album is “Why Is There Air?” (1965), recorded at the Flamingo Hotel in Las Vegas, Nevada—so citing Harrah’s Lake Tahoe in Stateline, Nevada was wrong. The Planner also added an incorrect note claiming Harrah’s Lake Tahoe later rebranded to Harveys Lake Tahoe.
